title: Chinese Stew with Ginger
description: A hearty Chinese stew made with ginger and a variety of spices. Perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced ginger and cook for 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the stew beef and cook until browned.
Add the soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, and cornstarch. Stir to combine.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour or until the beef is tender.
Garnish with green onions and serve hot.
